blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A group of business processing outsourcing (BPO) employees has warned that it will launch a coordinated work stoppage if the government fails to enact legislative and policy measures to provide them just transition and other employment benefits. The BPO Employees Solidarity (BES) held its first general assembly on Saturday, November 28, to discuss the threats and impacts of artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and corporate restructuring to their livelihoods.
